subject: IR playbook acceptance and timeboxed evidence share
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@clearport.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: IR playbook acceptance and timeboxed evidence share

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the tabletop earlier. Clearport asked us to provide the incident response (IR) playbook PDF, a short set of supporting artifacts (auth and telemetry slices), and a temporary transfer window for forensic evidence access. Before we share anything I need confirmation on a couple of constraints from your side so legal & security are comfortable: 

- A timeboxed SFTP (or secure link) window of no more than 7 days, after which access is revoked.
- Confirmation that files will be retained only for the purpose of the SOC 2 audit and then deleted/returned (please state retention policy).
- A redaction checklist for customer PII/tenant identifiers we should apply prior to sharing.

We can provide the following artifacts in the initial bundle: IR_Playbook_v2.0.pdf (master runbook), auth-logs-sample.tar.gz (redacted sample), telemetry-summary.csv (7-day sample), and a short sanitized timeline (text). We would like Clearport to sign a short access agreement (one-page addendum) that lists allowed use and deletion expectations.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: confirm acceptance of the access addendum and retention window.
- Thu 03/04: we upload the initial bundle to a temporary SFTP link (or provide DocuSign + link for access).
- Within 7 days: Clearport confirms receipt and completes review.

If you prefer DocuSign for the access addendum I can route that today.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: proposed-access-addendum.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@clearport.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clearport.com, Melissa Wang <melissa@auditwise.co>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: IR playbook acceptance and timeboxed evidence share

Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the clear proposed plan. We confirm the approach but have two small asks to finalize before you upload: 

1) We require the temporary access window to be exactly 5 business days from the time the link is created (not 7 calendar days).
2) We need an explicit list of fields you will redact from the auth logs (e.g. tenant_id, customer_email, full IP addresses) so our privacy team can sign off.

We will sign the short access addendum via DocuSign. Melissa from Auditwise is copied — they are coordinating the SOC 2 work on Clearport's side and will provide the SFTP instructions and a minimal evidence checklist for the items they actually need to validate (should save us time).

If acceptable, reply with the redaction list and we will send the DocuSign link.

Best,
Alex Byrne
Head of Security Engineering
Clearport Financial
alex.byrne@clearport.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@clearport.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IR playbook acceptance and timeboxed evidence share

Alex / team —

Thanks — confirmed, 5 business days works for us. Below is the redaction plan we'll apply before any transfer (we can share a redaction script if helpful):

Redaction plan (high level):
- tenant_id: replace with pseudo-id (tenant_xxx)
- customer_email / user_email: hashed (sha256 truncated)
- ip_address: last octet redacted (10.1.2.xxx) for IPv4; /64 masking for IPv6
- request_ids / trace ids: kept but truncated to first 8 chars
- request payloads containing PII: removed and reference created in a separate metadata file

Artifacts we will upload: 
- IR_Playbook_v2.0.pdf (full runbook, no redaction)
- sanitized-timeline.txt (human-readable sequence, redacted)
- auth-logs-sample-redacted.tar.gz (auth events, redacted per plan)
- telemetry-sample-7day.csv (aggregated counters, no PII)

We have attached the signed short access addendum (kimberly_signed_temp_access.pdf) and the redaction checklist as an Excel extract for your privacy team. Please provide the DocuSign link or SFTP destination and preferred contact.

Next steps I will take after I have the access link: schedule the upload and notify when files are live. Karthik, can you please prepare the sanitized timeline and confirm the telemetry slice (I will attach the artifacts and upload). Marissa, please take point on coordination with Legal if Clearport requests any retention exceptions.

We'll plan an internal review call next Tuesday; Melissa will confirm exact slot. Thanks for the responsiveness — this should keep the SOC 2 timeline on track.
